name: Bury St Edmunds Foodbank
short_description: Trussell Trust foodbank serving Bury St Edmunds
description: Part of The Trussell Trust network providing emergency food parcels. Based at Gatehouse Community Centre. Open Mon and Wed for distribution. Referral required via local agencies.

name: St Edmundsbury Borough Allotments
short_description: Council-managed allotment sites in Bury St Edmunds
description: St Edmundsbury Council manages multiple sites including Northgate Street
image: and Eastern Way. Plots from £30/year. Waiting lists operate for most sites.
area: Multiple sites across Bury St Edmunds

name: Bury St Edmunds Community Garden
description: Volunteer-run community garden behind the community centre. Grows organic vegetables and fruit with surplus shared among volunteers and local residents. Organic methods encouraged.

name: Bury St Edmunds Abbey Gardens Fruit Trees
short_description: Historic fruit trees in Abbey Gardens
description: Ancient apple and pear trees in the historic Abbey Gardens produce fruit available for public picking during harvest season. Maintained by volunteers from the Abbey Gardens Friends group.
